sentences.你性格和緩：不爭先、不記仇，很懂得把日子過得舒服。: You are easy-going by nature. You don't compete for attention, you don't hold on to resentment, and you have a real instinct for making life comfortable.
sentences.要留意的是：舒服會削弱你前進的動力，有時你需要一點外來的推力。: But that ease has a cost: when life is too comfortable your drive softens, and change comes more easily when something outside pushes you.
sentences.天同的課題不在苦，在動力——舒服本身會削弱移動的理由。: For Tian Tong, the challenge is not hardship but drive — when nothing forces you to move, comfort itself weakens your reasons to.
sentences.有一點壓力，對你反而是好事。: A certain amount of pressure actually works in your favour.
sentences.福氣厚，日子過得舒服，人緣寬，不必用力也有人願意幫。: You are well blessed: life is comfortable, you get on easily with people, and help comes without your having to push for it.
sentences.它的舒服是真的，不必替它擔心。: That ease is genuine; there's no need to distrust it.
sentences.天梁在命的基調是出面：遇到不公會說話，遇到有難的人會接。: Tian Liang in the Life Palace sets a keynote of stepping forward: you speak up when something is unfair, and you take in people who are struggling.
sentences.它有一套自己認定的標準，而且相當堅持。: You hold to a set of standards of your own, and you don't bend them easily.
sentences.天同化忌，想安頓而安頓不下，舒服的條件恰好最缺。: Here Tian Tong is touched by Obstruction: you want to settle, yet the very conditions for ease are the ones hardest to come by.
sentences.它的形狀是拖而不是痛。: What you feel is less pain than a recurring drag.
sentences.放假時你最懂得享受，一頓好飯、一個午覺就很滿足；只是舒服的位置坐久了，換工作、學: You know how to enjoy rest — a good meal and an afternoon nap are enough to make you content. But stay somewhere comfortable for too long, and big changes, like a new job or learning something new, usually need someone else's push first.

clauses.太陰處理資源的方式是慢慢積: Tai Yin has you build up slowly and steadily
